limits: Physical networks are undirected conservative reservations, not measured flows or a spare-capacity model.
Connected storage can join multiple production branches; these remain protected.
Only persistent saved factory/pipe connection components are traced; rail/truck/drone transfers and lightweight geometry require separate evidence.
Owner-reported industrial reservation remains authoritative even when a specific node has no direct extractor in this snapshot.

siting.method: Same logistics score, but protected western network +250m and saved buildable centres +32m are hard exclusions. Also exclude every existing extractor-node reference and plots covering natural nodes.
siting.limits: Bounds are saved actor centres, not full meshes or lightweight geometry. Water coordinate is a waterbody reference only; a separate pump location and all corridors remain unverified.
